basic_details.job_title: Panjab University Project Technical Support III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Panjab University has notified 1 vacancy for the Project Technical Support-III post on a project-based, temporary, and co-terminus basis under the Department of Biophysics, with an initial one-year appointment extendable up to 2 years. Candidates applying for this post require a three years B.Sc/graduate degree with three years' experience OR M.Sc./PG degree with minimum 55 percent marks in Biophysics/Biochemistry/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Allied fields, with preference given to those holding UGC-NET, GATE, or other national entrance tests. The notified pay is Rs. 28,000 + 5600 (20% HRA). Eli

important_dates.interview_date: To be communicated via email or phone to eligible candidates

how_to_apply: Prepare an application on plain paper.
Attach a detailed resume containing your email, address, and contact number.
Enclose attested copies of educational certificates, work experience proofs, and publications.

Submit the application package to Prof. Avneet Saini, Principal Investigator, Department of Biophysics, BMS Block-II, South Campus, Sector-25, Panjab University, Chandigarh-160014 on or before 23 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Panjab University Project Technical Support-III at a Glance

rows.details: Machine Learning and AI-Guided Design and Validation of Cost-Effective Next-Generation Antimicrobial Peptides Against Multidrug Resistant Pathogens
Initial appointment for one year, extendable up to 2 years

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential educational qualifications and age limits prescribed for the project post. Other relaxations are applicable as per ICMR and Panjab University norms. Essential Qualifications: Three years B.Sc/graduate degree with three years’ experience OR M.Sc./PG degree with a minimum of 55 percent marks in Biophysics/Biochemistry/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Allied fields. Candidates with UGC-NET/GATE/other national entrance test conducted by the Government of India will be preferred. Desirable Experience: Prior knowledge of molecular modelling, software, biomolecular simulations, various microbiology, biochemical and spectrophotometric assays, cell culture and molecular biology techniques. Age Limit: Maximum 35 years. Other relaxations as per ICMR and Panjab University norms are applicable.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Panjab University Project Technical Support-III
content_sections.text: Prepare an application on plain paper. Attach a detailed resume containing your email, address, and contact number. Enclose attested copies of educational certificates, work experience proofs, and publications. Submit the application package to Prof. Avneet Saini, Principal Investigator, Department of Biophysics, BMS Block-II, South Campus, Sector-25, Panjab University, Chandigarh-160014 on or before 23 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates will be shortlisted based on qualifications and experience. The date and venue of the interview will be communicated via email or phone to the eligible candidates. No separate call letter will be issued, and no TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

rows.date: To be communicated via email or phone to eligible candidates

faq.question: Q1. Is this position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The position is purely temporary, project-based, and co-terminus with the ICMR-sponsored research project.

faq.question: Q2. Are allowances paid on top of the base stipend?
faq.answer: Yes, selected candidates receive a stipend of Rs. 28,000 along with 20% HRA (Rs. 5,600).

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for age or category relaxations?
faq.answer: Other relaxations are applicable as per ICMR and Panjab University norms, up to the maximum age limit of 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates fulfilling the criteria are shortlisted, and the date and venue of the interview are conveyed via email or phone.

faq.question: Q5. What documents must be attached with the offline application?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach a detailed resume (with email, address, and contact number) along with attested copies of certificates and work experience or publications.
